turns.question: Which of 1 or 2 October 2026 had more precipitation in Amsterdam, and how many orders were placed by customers in the Netherlands on that day?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no precipitation (weather) metric, so I cannot say which day had more rain; the closest metrics are orders_total (Orders) by customer country, which I can give: customers in the Netherlands placed 3 orders on 1 October 2026 and 3 orders on 2 October 2026 (same on both days).
